name: requirely
description: Turns unstructured input into a structured understanding of what needs to be built.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @requirely/core run typecheck && pnpm --filter @requirely/ui run typecheck && pnpm --filter @requirely/web run typecheck && pnpm --filter @requirely/cli run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @requirely/core run test && pnpm --filter @requirely/cli run test
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm boundaries && pnpm node-runnable && pnpm test
